data.name: Eubulo
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'euboulos' which means 'well-counseled, well-spoken, good speaker'. In Greek mythology, Euboulos was the name of a wise and noble man who advised the Spartans during the Battle of Amphipolis.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes wise counsel and effective communication in relationships and spiritual growth.
data.numerology_meaning: Creative, artistic, and imaginative individuals with a strong desire for self-expression.

in_hebrew.name: אובולו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אובולו מקורו ביוונית, ונגזר מהמילה 'אובולוס' שמשמעותה 'דובדבן'. השם משויך לנוצרים בשל שימושו בברית החדשה, ויש לו חשיבות רבה במסורת הנוצרית. השם אובולו הוא סמלי ומרמז על מתיקות ועל טוב לב.

in_greek.name: Εὐβούλος
in_greek.meaning: Εὐ- (eu) σημαίνει 'καλός' και βούλος σημαίνει σχετιζεται με καρπός
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Εὐβούλος προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'καλός βούλος' ή 'καλή βουλή'. Ο Εὐβούλος ήταν και ένα όνομα κοινό στην αρχαία Ελλάδα. Στο Χριστιανισμό, το όνομα Εὐβούλος αναφέρεται στη Βίβλο, στο Β΄ Τιμόθεο 1:6-7, ως ένας πιστός συνεργάτης του Αποστόλου Παύλου.

in_latin.name: Eubulus
in_latin.meaning: Derived from Greek, meaning 'well-intentioned' or 'good will'
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Eubulus originates from Greek and was adopted into Latin. It signifies 'well-intentioned' or 'good will'. In Christian tradition, Eubulus is noted as a companion of Apostle Paul, mentioned in the New Testament, specifically in 2 Timothy 1:6-7. The name reflects positive attributes and spiritual significance.

in_english.name: Eubulo
in_english.meaning: Good will, well-intentioned, or kindly disposed
in_english.long_meaning: The name Eubulo, derived from the Greek 'Εὐβούλος' (Euboulos), means 'good will', 'well-intentioned', or 'kindly disposed'. It originates from the Greek words 'εὐ-' (eu-), meaning 'good', and 'βούλος' (boulos), related to 'will' or 'counsel'. Eubulo is mentioned in the New Testament in 2 Timothy 1:6-7 as one of Apostle Paul's companions. The name carries spiritual significance, symbolizing goodwill and kindness, and has been used in Christian tradition to signify positive attributes.

biblical_reference.note: Eubulus is mentioned as one of the Christians in Rome whom Paul greets.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Eubulo" carries a rich cultural heritage rooted in Ancient Greece. Its association with wisdom, good counsel, and well-spoken eloquence might inspire its bearers to live up to these ideals. Throughout history, this name has been borne by individuals who have used their counsel wisely and effectively, leaving a positive impact on their societies.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name "Eubulo" has a deeper spiritual meaning. It symbolizes the wise guidance of the Holy Spirit in our lives. By tapping into our innate spiritual wisdom, we can make well-informed decisions and lead a virtuous life rooted in love, compassion, and faith. It serves as a reminder that amidst the complexities of life, we possess an inner voice that points us towards the right path.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Eubulus was a Christian martyr in the persecution of Diocletian. The name Eubulo carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Eubulus was a Christian martyr during the persecution of Diocletian, and is venerated as a saint in the Catholic and Orthodox Churches.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Eubulo continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Peter Eubulo from Dublin, Ireland embodies the meaning of Eubulo - "Well-spoken, good speaker". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Eubulo, meaning "well-speaker" or "good-speaker" in Greek, represents the divine gift of eloquence and effective communication in the service of God and His people. It symbolizes the power of words to inspire, unite, and uplift, reflecting the Christian values of love, truth, and understanding.
